- Created BIND configuration and zone files, updated startup files, and changed DNS server images in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-n0tuq_rf/lab/lab.conf).
- Assumed an isolated, IPv4-only DNS hierarchy and MX priority 10 for both mail domains.
- Startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and the running lab was not tested.
